With verified:false and unchanged pass counts, there is no test proof of the fix. Would not merge as-is - needs docstring restored and dead code removed.

Independent replay shows original does shrink longest to 2 on [4,1,5,3,7,6,2] vs documented 3, so claim is plausible but unsupported by cited evidence.
